notes: Curated feasibility metadata for docs/EXTENSION_MATRIX.md. 'verify' means behavior must be proven by a test before advertising. 'impossible' means no spec-valid Metal path on the supported GPU families.

GL_ARB_gpu_shader_fp64.reason: Apple GPUs and MSL have no fp64; a software double emulation would not satisfy GLSL fp64 semantics.

GL_NV_shader_atomic_float64.reason: Requires fp64 atomics; MSL/Apple GPUs do not expose fp64.

GL_ARB_shader_clock.reason: No per-invocation shader clock; only coarse GPU timestamps are available.

GL_ARB_derivative_control.reason: MSL exposes dfdx/dfdy/fwidth but no fine/coarse derivative control.

GL_NV_path_rendering.reason: No path-rendering hardware; a CPU path rasterizer is outside the scope of this layer.

GL_NV_command_list.reason: Vendor command-list token stream has no Metal equivalent; not worth a CPU interpreter.

GL_NV_draw_vulkan_image.reason: Metal has no Vulkan image interop.

GL_EXT_EGL_image_storage.reason: No EGL images on the Metal backend.

GL_NV_memory_object_sparse.reason: No external sparse memory objects; ARB_sparse_* is emulated by full allocation.

GL_ARB_imaging.reason: Legacy fixed-function imaging subset removed from the core profile; not applicable.

GL_INTEL_conservative_rasterization.reason: No conservative raster hardware; compute expansion is not spec-exact.

GL_NV_conservative_raster.reason: No conservative raster hardware; compute expansion is not spec-exact.

GL_ARB_robust_buffer_access_behavior.reason: Cannot guarantee robust behavior for arbitrary translated shaders without full bounds instrumentation.

GL_ARB_robustness_isolation.reason: No process/context isolation primitive in Metal.

GL_EXT_texture_compression_s3tc.gate: BC natively only on some Apple7/8 iPadOS; CPU decode fallback otherwise

GL_ARB_texture_compression_bptc.gate: BC natively only on some Apple7/8 iPadOS; CPU decode fallback otherwise

GL_ARB_texture_compression_rgtc.gate: BC natively only on some Apple7/8 iPadOS; CPU decode fallback otherwise

GL_NV_texture_rectangle_compressed.gate: BC natively only on some Apple7/8 iPadOS; CPU decode fallback otherwise

GL_ARB_bindless_texture.reason: Argument buffers; A11 is argument-buffer Tier 1, so limits are lower than desktop GL.

GL_ARB_sparse_texture.reason: Allocate full storage; page commitment is a no-op and queries report committed.

GL_ARB_sparse_buffer.reason: Full buffer allocation; page commitment is a no-op.

GL_EXT_direct_state_access.reason: Core-object DSA subset is implementable; legacy client/matrix state is not valid in core.

GL_ARB_texture_border_clamp.reason: Metal sampler border color is limited; arbitrary border color needs shader emulation.

GL_ARB_texture_filter_minmax.reason: Metal samplers lack min/max filtering; emulate with shader taps.

GL_EXT_texture_filter_minmax.reason: Metal samplers lack min/max filtering; emulate with shader taps.

GL_ARB_cull_distance.reason: MSL exposes clip_distance but not cull_distance; map to clip as an approximation.

GL_ARB_provoking_vertex.reason: Reorder indices/expand strips to match the requested provoking-vertex convention.

GL_ARB_geometry_shader4.reason: Metal has no geometry stage; compute fallback on A11 and mesh path on Apple7+.

GL_ARB_tessellation_shader.reason: Metal tessellation pipeline (tess factor buffer + post-tessellation vertex function).

GL_ARB_transform_feedback2.reason: No native transform-feedback stage; capture via shader writes/second pass.

GL_ARB_transform_feedback3.reason: No native transform-feedback stage; capture via shader writes/second pass.

GL_ARB_transform_feedback_instanced.reason: No native transform-feedback stage; capture via shader writes/second pass.

GL_OVR_multiview.reason: Multi-pass layered rendering; no native multiview draw.

GL_OVR_multiview2.reason: Multi-pass layered rendering; no native multiview draw.

GL_EXT_multiview_timer_query.reason: Multi-pass layered rendering with per-view timer queries.

GL_AMD_performance_monitor.gate: Metal GPU counters; availability depends on device and counter set

GL_INTEL_performance_query.gate: Metal GPU counters; availability depends on device and counter set

GL_NV_framebuffer_mixed_samples.reason: Metal render passes require a single sample count; resolve/expand as needed.

GL_NV_framebuffer_multisample_coverage.reason: No separate coverage-sample count; approximate with MSAA.

GL_EXT_raster_multisample.reason: No separate raster/color sample counts; approximate with MSAA.

GL_NV_shader_atomic_fp16_vector.reason: MSL has no half-vector atomics; emulate with CAS.

GL_NV_shader_subgroup_partitioned.reason: MSL SIMD-group operations cover most of this; partitioned ballots need emulation.

GL_ARB_vertex_attrib_64bit.reason: No fp64 vertex pipeline; downconvert attributes to float.

GL_NV_vertex_attrib_integer_64bit.reason: No 64-bit integer vertex fetch; downconvert or split.

GL_ARB_framebuffer_object.reason: Core FBO path; renderbuffer storage still needs implementation.

GL_ARB_texture_storage.reason: Immutable texture storage is already mapped to Metal textures.

GL_EXT_window_rectangles.reason: Scissor/discard emulation over the supported window rectangles.

GL_MESA_framebuffer_swap_xy.reason: Swap X/Y in the vertex/output path.

GL_ARB_query_buffer_object.reason: Copy query results into buffer storage.

GL_ARB_transform_feedback_overflow_query.reason: Overflow flag on the emulated XFB capture.

GL_ARB_shader_subroutine.reason: Translate subroutine uniforms to a switch in MSL.

GL_ARB_gpu_shader_int64.reason: MSL long/ulong and 64-bit integer uniform support.

GL_ARB_spirv_extensions.reason: SPIR-V input via SPIRV-Cross; requires vendored dependency.

GL_EXT_shader_framebuffer_fetch_non_cohe.reason: MSL framebuffer fetch plus a barrier.
